title: Funky Head Boxers Plus
native_title: ファンキー・ヘッド・ボクサーズ＋
overview:
The proud third entry in the Yoshimoto Funky series! Young comedians run wild in the ring once again! Can you reach the summit of technique and laughs!!

The deadly gag punch.
Weirdness that hits you right on the head.
Comedians' guts on full display!
The backfist of laughter explodes!
Hilarious face deformation!
A gag that totally bombs
Hooked on the gag punch

Funky Head Boxers Plus is an updated version of Yoshimoto's take on Sega's arcade comedy boxing game. Yoshimoto comedians climb into the ring as boxers with giant cube-shaped heads that squash and warp with every hit. Throw punches, pull off special gag punches with joystick commands and go for the knockout, either training up and taking on one computer opponent after another or facing a friend head to head.

- 1 or 2 players
- Memory backup save
